name: Tender Finance
rootCause: Tender.fi is suspected of being attacked by white hat hackers and lost $1.59 million. Hackers used Tender.fi’s misconfigured oracles to borrow $1.59 million worth of crypto assets with just $70 worth of GMX tokens as collateral. On March 8, on-chain data showed that the hackers who attacked the Arbitrum ecological lending protocol Tender.fi had returned their funds, and the Tender.fi team agreed to pay the hackers 62 ETH ($96,500) as a bounty.

descriptions.text: Tender.fi is suspected of being attacked by white hat hackers and lost $1.59 million. Hackers used Tender.fi’s misconfigured oracles to borrow $1.59 million worth of crypto assets with just $70 worth of GMX tokens as collateral. On March 8, on-chain data showed that the hackers who attacked the Arbitrum ecological lending protocol Tender.fi had returned their funds, and the Tender.fi team agreed to pay the hackers 62 ETH ($96,500) as a bounty.

Tender Finance suffered a major exploit on Arbitrum on 7 March 2023. An oracle integration bug caused the GMX collateral price to be drastically inflated, allowing an attacker to drain $1.6 million in assets. The exploiter returned the funds after negotiation. A miscalculation in Tender Finance's GMX oracle caused it to report tGMX values with 38 decimals instead of 18, inflating collateral prices and enabling massive over-borrowing by depositing 1 GMX.
